F-grouse-atv-0045.name: By Sanca Creek
F-grouse-atv-0045.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
F-grouse-atv-0045.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (East Fork FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Road: East Fork FSR, 5.4 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
3 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-6: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 4 table (pages 39 and 40), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Pages 36 to 41 print no LEH list.

plan: Drive: from Cranbrook, about 82 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.38499, -116.61817, where the truck road ends (East Fork FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: the East Fork FSR stretch, 5.4 km one way. About 108 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-6, Region 4. CWD zone: deer, elk and moose heads go to a CWD freezer; brain and spine stay in the zone. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-26, closures 2026-10-03.
